title: Commutativity of Factor Ring R/P via *-Reverse P-Derivations
summary: In this paper, we establish commutativity criteria for the quotient ring $R/P$ through pairs of $\ast$-reverse $P$-derivations satisfying suitable commutator and anti-commutator differential identities. As applications, a number of results concerning $\ast$-reverse derivations on prime rings are recovered.
